fields.label: Device Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the client-supplied device_id. The raw id is never stored.

fields.label: User
fields.description: The anonymous account this device owns.

fields.label: Secret Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the client-held device_secret. Presenting the matching secret is what proves ownership of this account at re-bootstrap.

fields.label: Android ID Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the app-scoped Android ID, recorded only on a passing Play Integrity verdict. Lets a reinstall on the same phone recover this account. At most one row holds a given hash.

fields.label: Bootstrap Count
fields.description: How many times this device has re-fetched its keys. A sudden jump is worth investigating.

fields.label: Attestation Verdict
fields.description: Compact Play Integrity result recorded at bootstrap: reason, pass flag, and the device/app verdicts Google returned. Empty for devices that sent no token.

fields.label: Attestation Mode
fields.description: The play_integrity_mode in force when this verdict was recorded (audit / enforce). Without it an old row cannot be read correctly after the mode changes.
